parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_sync (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    sfdc_project_id VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    lockated_project_id INTEGER,
    project_name TEXT,
    source_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    sync_status VARCHAR(50),
    last_synced_at TIMESTAMP,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

parameters.query:
SELECT
    id,
    sfdc_project_id,
    lockated_project_id,
    project_name,
    source_hash,
    sync_status,
    last_synced_at
FROM project_sync;

INSERT INTO project_sync (
    sfdc_project_id,
    lockated_project_id,
    project_name,
    source_hash,
    sync_status,
    last_synced_at,
    updated_at
)
VALUES (
    {{ $json.sfdc_project_id }},
    {{ $json.lockated_project_id }},
    '{{ $json.project_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ $json.source_hash }}',
    '{{ $json.sync_status }}',
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
ON CONFLICT (sfdc_project_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    lockated_project_id = EXCLUDED.lockated_project_id,
    project_name = EXCLUDED.project_name,
    source_hash = EXCLUDED.source_hash,
    sync_status = EXCLUDED.sync_status,
    last_synced_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

SELECT
    sfdc_project_id,
    lockated_project_id,
    project_name
FROM project_sync
ORDER BY id;
